characters.summary: Duke Nukem relies on a vast arsenal of high-explosive weaponry, ballistic firearms, and overwhelming physical strength to mow down alien invaders. He utilizes sheer bravado, steroids for enhanced resilience, and various futuristic gadgets to dominate close-quarters and ranged combat alike.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to environmental hazards if caught off guard
